import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Sleep Disorder
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sleep_disorder_colors = {'Sleep Apnea': '#e74c3c', 'Insomnia': '#f39c12', 'NaN': '#3498db'}
for disorder in df['Sleep Disorder'].unique():
    if pd.isna(disorder):
        mask = df['Sleep Disorder'].isna()
        label = 'None'
        color = sleep_disorder_colors['NaN']
    else:
        mask = df['Sleep Disorder'] == disorder
        label = disorder
        color = sleep_disorder_colors.get(disorder, '#95a5a6')
    
    ax1.scatter(df[mask]['Sleep Duration'], df[mask]['Quality of Sleep'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=80, label=label, color=color, edgecolors='white', linewidth=0.5)

ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', framealpha=0.9)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 2. Average Sleep Duration by Occupation
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors_grad = plt.cm.viridis(np.linspace(0.3, 0.9, len(occupation_sleep)))
bars = ax2.barh(range(len(occupation_sleep)), occupation_sleep.values, color=colors_grad, edgecolor='white', linewidth=1.5)
ax2.set_yticks(range(len(occupation_sleep)))
ax2.set_yticklabels(occupation_sleep.index, fontsize=9)
ax2.set_xlabel('Average Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Average Sleep Duration by Occupation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='x', linestyle='--')
for i, v in enumerate(occupation_sleep.values):
    ax2.text(v + 0.05, i, f'{v:.2f}', va='center', fontsize=8)

# 3. Correlation Heatmap of Numerical Variables
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
numerical_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                  'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', center=0, 
            square=True, ax=ax3, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8}, linewidths=1, linecolor='white')
ax3.set_title('Correlation Matrix of Health Metrics', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax3.set_xticklabels(ax3.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax3.set_yticklabels(ax3.get_yticklabels(), rotation=0, fontsize=9)

# 4. Stress Level Distribution by BMI Category and Gender
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
bmi_order = ['Normal', 'Normal Weight', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
existing_bmi = [bmi for bmi in bmi_order if bmi in df['BMI Category'].unique()]
if not existing_bmi:
    existing_bmi = df['BMI Category'].unique()

df_filtered = df[df['BMI Category'].isin(existing_bmi)]
bmi_gender_stress = df_filtered.groupby(['BMI Category', 'Gender'])['Stress Level'].mean().reset_index()

x_pos = np.arange(len(existing_bmi))
width = 0.35

males = []
females = []
for bmi in existing_bmi:
    male_val = bmi_gender_stress[(bmi_gender_stress['BMI Category'] == bmi) & 
                                  (bmi_gender_stress['Gender'] == 'Male')]['Stress Level'].values
    female_val = bmi_gender_stress[(bmi_gender_stress['BMI Category'] == bmi) & 
                                    (bmi_gender_stress['Gender'] == 'Female')]['Stress Level'].values
    males.append(male_val[0] if len(male_val) > 0 else 0)
    females.append(female_val[0] if len(female_val) > 0 else 0)

ax4.bar(x_pos - width/2, males, width, label='Male', color='#3498db', alpha=0.8, edgecolor='white', linewidth=1.5)
ax4.bar(x_pos + width/2, females, width, label='Female', color='#e74c3c', alpha=0.8, edgecolor='white', linewidth=1.5)
ax4.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Average Stress Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Average Stress Level by BMI Category and Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.set_xticks(x_pos)
ax4.set_xticklabels(existing_bmi, fontsize=9)
ax4.legend(framealpha=0.9)
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y', linestyle='--')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
